key_insight: The paper shows that a treasury optimization problem can be reformulated as a QUBO and solved on IBM quantum hardware with the same optimal answer as a classical exact solver on a small test instance.
engineering_relevance: It demonstrates a practical pathway for mapping constrained financial scheduling and cash-flow allocation problems onto near-term quantum workflows.
method: Formulated the Color-of-Money problem as a constrained MILP.
Converted the MILP into a QUBO for quantum execution.
Used a VQA with Pauli Correlation Encoding and error mitigation on IBM hardware.
evidence_signal: A prototype instance with 3 assets, 3 obligations, and 2 time periods was run on real IBM quantum hardware and matched the optimal solution from the SCIP exact solver.
watch_item: The validation is limited to a very small proof-of-concept instance, so scalability and performance on larger noisy problems remain unproven.
paper_title: Quantum Optimization of the Color-of-Money Problem on IBM Quantum Hardware: A Proof-of-Concept Study
